Saturday Night Live Halloween Cold Open Features Surprise Cameos

“Saturday Night Live” aired a holiday-themed cold open featuring the return of Tom Hanks as his fan-favorite character David S. Pumpkins. According to reports published by entertainment media, the Halloween-night episode integrated several celebrity impressions and political satire into a fictional amusement park ride sketch.

Key Appearances and Highlights

  • Tom Hanks: Reprised his dorky-dancing David S. Pumpkins role, originally debuted in 2016, alongside skeleton-suited backup dancers Mikey Day and returning guest Bobby Moynihan.
  • James Austin Johnson: Portrayed President Trump, delivering political jokes concerning upcoming midterm elections and making satirical remarks.
  • Saidah Belo-Osagie: Appeared as a spoof of Nicki Minaj, poking fun at the musician's vocal support for political movements.

Practical Implications and Verification

The sketch parodied recent political rhetoric and campaign trail commentary. Viewers interested in verifying the details of the broadcast can watch the full segment on the official “Saturday Night Live” YouTube channel or stream the complete episode via official network platforms.
